messages:
Olivia Chen: AmberCore EAP lab access confirmed for Mon 03:00 UTC. We need NDA signed + telemetry & SSH creds. Can Legal confirm? Ops: what's required to onboard the board?

Jake Patel: I pinged Legal yesterday — @Legal any update? Also need to know which image we should flash.

Maria Gomez: Got a signed NDA PDF via DocuSign, uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/ambercore/nda-2797654321. AmberCore needs S3 write + an SSH jump host. Also they asked for a single daily contact.

Trent Alvarez: I'll open an ops ticket for SSH jump and S3 bucket. Any bench harness details? dataset? workloads?

Olivia Chen: Perf + stability first pass. Run open-source harness perf.py with seq=1024, warmup=100, 10k iterations if possible. Use q8_0 model variant. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU temp and oom counts.

Jake Patel: Sample run command:

```bash
./bench --model q8_0 --seq 1024 --warmup 100 \
  --iters 10000 --measure p50,p95,p99,tokens_per_sec \
  --output s3://ambercore-redwood/eap/2797654321/run-$(date +%s).json
```

Maria Gomez: AmberCore requested a daily 15min sync M-F. Suggest owners: @Trent (Eng-ops) + @Nate (Partner Success). They also floated a co-authored 'preview' blog for after closed beta — hold until results stable.

Trent Alvarez: Scheduling daily stand next week. Quick heads-up: previous boards showed thermal throttling under long seq, so watch temp profiles and throttling events.

Olivia Chen: Telemetry keys — use per-tenant KMS-wrapped keys and rotate after EAP. @security-bot can you create a ticket to provision?

security-bot: Created SEC-4821 to provision a customer-specific KMS key and HSM wrapping for ambercore-eap. ETA 2 business days.

Legal: NDA confirmed, sending signed copy to the thread. No export control flags. Please avoid sharing microcode dumps or raw silicon logs outside legal-approved channels.

Jake Patel: :thumbsup: OK. Ops ticket number when ready? Also who owns the announcement skeleton?

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the joint announcement skeleton but won't share externally until we have stable bench results. I'll put draft in /docs/partners/ambercore/announce-draft.md and post here.

Olivia Chen: Great. Checklist for next steps: 1) Ops ticket + SSH creds, 2) KMS key, 3) run perf harness, 4) daily sync, 5) announce draft. I'll follow up after first run. Thanks all.
